mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where HOUST increased for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 1% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over three months signals a supply-side contraction, which leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 2% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS grew by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 2% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5% over the same period, it signals a strong economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows > 2% quarter-over-quarter and UNRATE decreases > 0.5%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where GDPC1 grew by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5%.
